propositions: The per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (440 requests worst case) and discards verified work wholesale when primary fails; replace with incremental criterion banking and batched successor runs over unverified remainder.
Primary verification must record criterion verdicts as soon as confident (not batched at end) and feed criterion IDs + banked summaries into successor prompts to avoid re-verifying completed work.

The flat _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 floor hands small tickets 10x their needed budget, manufacturing runaway exhaustion; replace with criteria-scaled verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c, 48, 480) to converge without recovery.

Recovery pool is budgeted per criteria count c: N=ceil(floor/2); successor batches cap at 8-12 criteria per model class; zero-progress stops recovery; deterministic fallback finalizes from bank if LLM fails twice.

Run-scoped git-ignored bank stores criterion verdicts (ID, verbatim text, evidence, truncated flag) with ticket/material/tree stamps; successor preflight validates stamps; emitted verdict embeds banked evidence uncompressed.

Path-normalized read_file memo: cache whole-file content on first read of a path, slice all ranges from cache (any line_start/line_end) to collapse 77% re-read waste from re-reads at different ranges.
